name: Go Fishin!
summary:
Catch fish. Sell your catch. Upgrade your crew. Build your fishing empire.

Go Fishin! is an incremental 2D fishing game where you progress through six different islands to catch 144 different species while upgrading their crew and rod.
Move your bobber over the shadows under the surface and hold it there until the fish is hooked. Common fish are easy. Rare ones dart around, and legendary fish only stick around for a few seconds. At the end of each trip, sell your catch, spend it on the upgrade tree and head back out stronger.
